title: Two and a half tribes across the Jordan
english: On the two and a half tribes and the nine and a half. [[Moses allotted land east of the Jordan to the two and a half tribes — Reuben, Gad, and the half-tribe of Manasseh >> Bible:Joshua 13:8]]. To the rest not Moses but Jesus divides the land. Yet a covenant was struck: leaving women and little ones behind, the fighting men would help their brothers until those too received their inheritance. After Moses’ death Jesus presses the promise. So much for the history; we who have turned to the Lord, who [[removes the veil from the reading of the old covenant >> Bible:2 Corinthians 3:14-16]], know that [[these things happened figuratively to them and were written for us, on whom the ends of the ages have come >> Bible:1 Corinthians 10:11]]. Let us rise from letter to spirit.
translator_notes: Copy-text Baehrens GCS 30 / Origenes Werke VII (1921), Rufinus Latin.
True OET: no ANF; do not copy Bruce FOTC 105 (Joshua).

title: Firstborn under Moses aid their brothers
english: All who receive a share through Moses are firstborn: Reuben from Leah, Gad from Zilpah, Manasseh from Asenath. Not by chance — two peoples are foreshadowed: one firstborn by nature, the other receiving inheritance by faith and grace. Those justified under the law are not given rest until they help their brothers in battle. Women and little ones receive quiet; the strong men go out to help. See how they aid me today in life’s contest: Isaiah lights me with his reading; Jeremiah comes girded and drives off the heart’s dark foes with the darts of his scroll; Daniel warns of Christ’s kingdom and Antichrist’s fraud; Ezekiel signs heavenly mysteries in the wheels; Hosea leads the twelve, all [[girding their loins with truth >> Bible:Ephesians 6:14]] to help their brothers. An infant — one who does not speak — cannot help me; a woman the Apostle calls a [[weaker vessel >> Bible:1 Peter 3:7]] does not come to the clash. Those who come from Moses’ land say: [[As we heard Moses, so will we hear you >> Bible:Joshua 1:17]] — whoever hears Moses must hear Jesus also, for [[Moses wrote of him >> Bible:John 5:46]].
translator_notes: Copy-text Baehrens GCS 30 / Origenes Werke VII (1921), Rufinus Latin.
True OET: no ANF; do not copy Bruce FOTC 105 (Joshua).

title: Half-tribes and the incomplete Trinity
english: Not three whole tribes under Moses nor nine whole under Jesus, but two and a half and nine and a half — one tribe is split. This signals that those under the law touched knowledge of the Trinity only [[in part >> Bible:1 Corinthians 13:9]]; they still lacked full knowledge of the Only-begotten’s incarnation. [[Many prophets and righteous longed to see what you see and did not see it >> Bible:Matthew 13:17]]. So they are neither two alone — lest the fathers be left outside Trinitarian faith — nor three complete — lest the sacrament seem already fulfilled in them. The altar they built was not the true altar but a type of the true one with Jesus; hence they overthrew few hostile kings — only [[Sihon and Og >> Bible:Numbers 21:21-35]]. Where Jesus leads the army, [[five kings fall and are hanged on the tree >> Bible:Joshua 10:26]]; twenty-nine are cut down; every uncleanness that held the holy land in malice’s bitterness is wiped out.

title: Rahab the breadth of the church
english: Jesus sends spies into Jericho; they are received by the harlot Rahab. They may be read as [[angels God sends before his face to prepare his way >> Bible:Matthew 11:10]]. [[Harlots and tax collectors believed and were baptized >> Bible:Matthew 21:32]]. Rahab means “breadth” — Christ’s church gathered from sinners. She says: [[The place is too narrow for me; enlarge your cords >> Bible:Isaiah 49:20; 54:2]]. She lodges the spies upstairs; no one sent by Jesus lies low on the ground. From harlot she becomes prophetess: [[I know the Lord your God has given you this land >> Bible:Joshua 2:9]]. She confesses the past, believes the present, prophesies the future. Japheth too means enlargement — the people saved from the nations; Canaan is made a servant so that by obedience he may find salvation.

title: Scarlet cord — no salvation outside the house
english: The wise harlot gives the spies a heavenly counsel: [[Go by the mountain way >> Bible:Joshua 2:16]] — flee the low valleys; preach what is high. She sets a [[scarlet cord in her house >> Bible:Joshua 2:18]] — the form of blood; there is no salvation except in Christ’s blood. [[All found in your house will be saved; we are clear of those who go out >> Bible:Joshua 2:19]]. Whoever would be saved, come into this house — the church — where Christ’s blood is the sign of redemption. With those who said [[His blood be on us and on our children >> Bible:Matthew 27:25]], that blood is unto condemnation. [[Jesus was set for the fall and rising of many >> Bible:Luke 2:34]]. Outside this house — outside the church — no one is saved. The sign hangs in the window: the incarnation lets us see deity’s light not bare, but as through a window. Cleansed in water and Spirit and in the blood of Jesus Christ our Lord, [[to whom be glory forever. Amen >> Bible:Galatians 1:5]].
